title: Library search shows item names

pr.title: feat(editor): better library search + display names
pr.head: 2cd95915a83deea25e15d9d48294a4f311d291c4

bricks.name: Tooltip leaves with its item
bricks.job: A visible tooltip hides itself when the thing it points at disappears.
bricks.adds: When a hovered item is removed (filtered out by search, or the sidebar closes), no `pointerleave` fires, so the old tooltip used to stay on screen. Now a `MutationObserver` watches the page while a tooltip is open and hides it once its item is gone. The observer only exists while a tooltip is visible, so it costs nothing when idle.
bricks.connects: Lives inside the existing tooltip code. `hideTooltip` is now exported so other components can use it.

bricks.name: showTooltip() for any element
bricks.job: A function that shows the tooltip on any element, above or below it, with an optional delay.
bricks.adds: Before, a tooltip only worked by wrapping something in `<Tooltip>`. The show logic moves into `showTooltip()` so a library card can call it directly, and it gains `position: "top"`. The delay is skipped when another tooltip closed a moment ago, so moving across items feels instant.
bricks.connects: Calls `updateTooltip`, which starts the cleanup observer from the brick before. `<Tooltip>` itself now uses it too.

bricks.name: Escape clears the search
bricks.job: Pressing Escape in the search box clears the search instead of closing the sidebar.
bricks.adds: The sidebar listens for Escape to close itself. When there is search text, the search box now handles Escape first: it clears the text and stops the key from reaching the sidebar. A second Escape, with the box empty, still closes the sidebar.
bricks.connects: Added to the existing `TextField` search box in `LibraryMenuItems`.

bricks.name: Named card styles
bricks.job: Styles for a bigger library card: a square preview with the name underneath.
bricks.adds: A named card fills its grid cell and stays square. The preview takes the space left over, and the name gets one line of small text, cut off with an ellipsis when it is too long.
bricks.connects: Plain CSS. The card markup in the next brick uses these class names.

bricks.name: Name under the preview
bricks.job: A library card can render its name below the drawing.
bricks.adds: `LibraryUnit` takes a `name` and a `showName` flag. With the flag on, the drawing goes into a `library-unit__preview` box and the name sits under it. The loading placeholder gets the same size so the grid doesn't jump when items appear.
bricks.connects: Uses the class names from Named card styles.

bricks.name: Two-column grid style
bricks.job: A grid style with two wide columns for named cards.
bricks.adds: The normal library grid has four small columns. The `--named` variant has two, so each card is big enough to read its name. `minmax(0, 1fr)` stops a long name from stretching its column.
bricks.connects: Plain CSS, switched on by the next brick.

bricks.name: Grid showNames switch
bricks.job: The library grid component turns on the two-column style when asked.
bricks.adds: `LibraryMenuSectionGrid` takes a `showNames` prop and adds the `--named` class when it is set. Without the prop, the grid is unchanged.
bricks.connects: Applies the class from Two-column grid style.

bricks.name: Steady scrollbar space
bricks.job: The item list keeps room for its scrollbar so the content doesn't shift while you type.
bricks.adds: Searching makes the list grow and shrink, so the scrollbar kept appearing and vanishing and the cards jumped sideways. `scrollbar-gutter: stable` reserves that space all the time.
bricks.connects: One CSS line on the existing items list.

bricks.name: Name tooltip on hover
bricks.job: Hovering a named library item shows its name in a tooltip above it.
bricks.adds: The card calls `showTooltip` on pointer enter and `hideTooltip` on leave or press. It uses pointer events, not mouse events, so a touch tap doesn't leave the tooltip stuck. When the name is already visible under the card and not cut off, it skips the tooltip.
bricks.connects: Calls `showTooltip` and `hideTooltip` from the tooltip bricks, and checks the `library-unit__name` box from Name under the preview.

bricks.name: Section passes names down
bricks.job: The library section hands each item its name and the showNames flag.
bricks.adds: `LibraryMenuSection` gets a `showNames` prop and passes it, plus the item's `name`, to every card and to the loading placeholders.
bricks.connects: Feeds the `name` and `showName` props that Name under the preview added.

bricks.name: Search results show names
bricks.job: Only the search results turn names on.
bricks.adds: Two words: `showNames` on the grid and on the section, in the branch that renders while searching. The normal library view keeps its compact four-column grid.
bricks.connects: Switches on Grid showNames switch and Section passes names down.

bricks.name: Escape tests
bricks.job: Two tests that Escape clears search or selection before it closes the sidebar.
bricks.adds: The tests load a library with two items, `wall` and `door`, and open the sidebar. One types a search and presses Escape twice: the first clears the box, the second closes the sidebar. The other selects an item and checks Escape clears the selection and leaves the sidebar open.
bricks.connects: Drives the search box from Escape clears the search.
checks: should clear an active search instead of closing the sidebar
should clear the item selection instead of closing the sidebar

summary: While you search the library, results now show as two columns of bigger cards with each item's name under its drawing.
Hovering any named item shows its name in a tooltip above it, built on a new `showTooltip()` that works on any element.
Tooltips now vanish when their item disappears, so filtering or closing the sidebar no longer leaves one stuck on screen.
Escape in the search box clears the search first, and only closes the sidebar once the box is empty.
The list keeps room for its scrollbar so cards don't jump as you type, and two tests pin the Escape behaviour.
